newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse ends up, eyes on U.S. FOMC outcome.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse ends up, eyes on U.S. FOMC outcome.

text.p: 1535 GMT - Belgian shares held onto most of their earlier gains, with Bel-20 index closing up 22 points, as market already anticipating U.S. Federal Reserve's FOMC to hike interest rates by 25 basis-points.
* Dealers said most investors were on the sidelines awaiting direction from the U.S., and underlined that if interest rates rose more than expected this would spark a major share sell-off.
* Bel-20 .BFX closed up 1.06 percent at 2,106.18, with a modest 2.3 billion francs volume of Belgian shares traded.
* Main Bel-20 gainer Societe Generale de Belgique (SGB), up 2.49 percent at 2,880 francs.
